reason: Paused and recovered cost payments: PendingCostMoveResume::CounterAdditionUnlessPayment gains unpaid_suffix (UnpaidCostSuffix: its payer and the remainder still owed, either the unpaid legs of a paused unless effect-cost or the count of a repeated draw cost's remaining instructions), WaitingFor::UnlessPayment and the mana-ability resume gain repeat (the compact age-counter count of a cumulative-upkeep draw cost), PendingContinuation gains head_payment_origin (a queued PayCost remainder resumes a payment already chosen), PendingCast gains activation_cost_paused_on_draw, ResolutionPaymentTransaction gains recovered (the accepted prefix and cursor of a staged payment kept across another player's concession), and DerivedViews gains unless_draw_cost (the resolved draw count and repetition the client renders, and the stage that tells it whether a repeated payment already begun can still be declined). An older peer drops these keys, settling a paused or repeated cost with legs unpaid, paying one draw for many, re-gating a latched remainder as a fresh choice, or replaying a staged payment's accepted prefix from the base. PendingCostMoveResume also gains ReplacementMayCostInnerChoice (an accepted entry MayCost parked while its leg's own replacement choice is answered), which an older peer cannot decode.
